title: Co-Brand Card Phone Credit for Crestline Companion Holders
content:
A co-brand card phone credit is given against the phone booking fee of a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes booking. It follows the miles credited to the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program by co-brand card partner accrual entries dated in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date.

| Miles from co-brand card partner accrual entries in the last 12 months | Co-brand card phone credit |
|---|---|
| 60000 or more | 5 USD |
| 25000 to fewer than 60000 | 3 USD |
| fewer than 25000 | nothing |

Boundaries: 60000 miles gives 5 USD and 59999 gives 3 USD; 25000 gives 3 USD and 24999 gives nothing (hypothetical figures on the edges of the bands).
